items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you know anything about Leroy's Dallas band Leroy who? Leroy's Dallas band. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I think that was a part of the Blue Moon Chasers.

ctx.x: That's right. Even this running over the horn, the bebop or whatever they call it, there's no feeling there. And the first thing that I learned when I studied music was that music was the combination of sounds that was pleasing to the ear. Now when it deviates from there,
well you don't have anything. That's right. May I ask a question here? Do you know anything about Leroy's Dallas band Leroy who? Leroy's Dallas band. They recorded on Columbia, Bill.

I think that was a part of the Blue Moon Chasers. Now I'm not sure. Well, who were the Blue Moon Chasers? It was a group of young fellows that had gotten together in Bud Johnson. That's a tenor player. You might know him. Bud Johnson was one of the original members.
